involvement.title: Choose the way you want to contribute.
involvement.intro: Start with the path that fits your current role. The team reviews every volunteering and partnership enquiry before making a commitment.
involvement.membershipBody: Explore individual or corporate membership directly with Optica, including the wider professional network and member benefits.
involvement.volunteerBody: Help shape events, outreach, community operations, or digital work. Availability and responsibilities are agreed with a human coordinator.
involvement.partnerBody: Universities, research groups, companies, and institutions can start a scoped conversation with the Local Section.

viewer.label: Interactive conceptual integrated photonics chip model
viewer.summary: A conceptual photonic integrated circuit: gold paths represent guided optical routes, rings represent resonators, and grating couplers connect light into and out of the chip. It illustrates component relationships, not a fabrication-ready design.
viewer.hint: Drag to orbit. Use a scroll wheel or pinch gesture to zoom.
viewer.fallback: A concise text model is shown because interactive graphics are unavailable on this device.
